# Amphion

> Amphion is desktop software for architecture practices on macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10/11. You describe in text or speech what you want; Amphion builds a real 3D model from building elements (walls, slabs, columns, windows, stairs) with dimensions, layers and quantities, and draws plans, sections, elevations and detail sheets from it. Made for sole practitioners and small offices.

## Product

- [Amphion](https://amphion3d.com/): build with language instead of drawing line by line. Export formats: 3dm, IFC, DXF, STEP, PDF. Projects stay on the user's computer. The Mac version is notarized by Apple.

## Pricing (excluding VAT)

- Amphion Manual: 49 € per month. The complete program for manual modelling (elements, imports, drawings, all exports, all updates) with 3 AI requests a month to get to know the AI.
- Amphion: 149 € per month. Everything in Manual plus the AI chat without a monthly limit on the strong models (fair use).
- Amphion Office: 399 € per month for 3 seats, each further seat 129 €, one invoice.
- Yearly payment: 2 months free. Money back in the first month.
